# Parallel gzip dependency

Unmodified pigz 2.8 sources by Mark Adler, downloaded from https://www.zlib.net/pigz/pigz-2.8.tar.gz.

SHA-256: `eb872b4f0e1f0ebe59c9f7bd8c506c4204893ba6a8492de31df416f0d5170fd0`.

Built with `NOZOPFLI` because Bottle Archive uses gzip levels 1, 6 and 9. The executable links macOS zlib and pthread support. The upstream licence is in README and the source headers.
